I often experience difficulty in doing my prayers on time and find that I may be risking my chances of succeeding in my program as I risk offending my supervisors who can make my life difficult. Is it ok to delay prayers beyond their proper time and make them up later to protect my standing and chances for success, so that inshallah (God-willing) I can secure a good career. What are the limits of compromising on our principles when faced with intimidation or a threat to our careers or goals in life? 2061 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. I ask this because its mentioned in several ahadith to stand close as much as possible together to one another in the rows with the shoulders, knees, ankles, feets. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32659 Country: India Title: Namaz and Zikr Question: I trust on My Allah and Rasool Sallalahu Alaihi Wasallam . Allah has been very Kind on Me and my Family. I am Employed and do 5 times namaz but most will be Qaza, Am worried on that part that most are qaza.While doing Salaah, all Duniya Khayalat/other things comes to mind and not able to concentrate. I want to do Namaz on time without fail but not able to and also do namaz with full concentration. I Earn good salary but no barkath, always health and other issues at home.There is no Sukuun in our life. My recitation. Before leaving home and entering home i recite Ayat ul Kursi. After my Namaz i read Surah Fatiha, Surah Iklas, Surah Falaq, Surah Naas, Ayat ul Kursi and Durood Ibrahim (All 3 times) and then make Dua and after that will recite Surah Iklas 11 times, Ayat Ul Kursi 3 times , Kalima ( NO count on that ) and Durood Ibrahim 7 times and then go to Sleep. Please Guide me in doing My namaz and Zikr by heart. Answer ID: 32659 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1226/766/H=1432) Missing salah, rather laziness in salah, unlawful gaze and distrust cause the khushu (dedication) of salah to vanish. Keep yourself away from these sins, then you shall feel satisfaction, pleasure and peace of mind by Zikr, Tilawah in your worship. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
